articles.title: Meta turns compute into revenue; launches "vibe-coded" game Pocket
articles.summary: Meta is reportedly pivoting to monetize excess AI compute capacity while launching Pocket, a new AI-integrated casual game created with "vibe-coding" workflows. Source: TechCrunch July 4, 2026.

articles.title: Google Nano Banana 2 Lite released for fast, cheap image gen
articles.summary: Google expanded its Nano model family with Banana 2 Lite, a lightweight text-to-image model designed for mobile performance and lowered cost. Source: TechCrunch July 4, 2026.

articles.title: Anything-LLM Native MCP Integration bridges local vs cloud gap
articles.summary: Mintplex-Labs integrated the Model Context Protocol (MCP) into Anything-LLM, allowing local models to use the same tool-discovery mechanisms as Claude Desktop. Source: GitHub July 4, 2026.

articles.title: PPL: 28,000 without power following Cumberland County storms
articles.summary: Major outages reported Sunday morning in Pennsylvania as PPL crews work on restoration following holiday weekend storms. Source: Cumberlink July 5, 2026.
